title: SD-JWT Disclosure Workbench
description: Issues and presents Selective Disclosure JWTs (RFC 9901) client-side: salted-hash per-claim disclosures, holder-binding KB-JWT, and a live what-the-verifier-sees panel showing exactly the disclosed subset.

selective_keys.description: Top-level claim keys marked selectively disclosable

Issued SD-JWT with all disclosures attached

presentation.description: Redacted presentation with an optional KB-JWT

disclosed_claims.description: Fully resolved claims a verifier would see

mcp_tool_definition.name: sdjwt_issue
mcp_tool_definition.description: Issues a Selective Disclosure JWT (RFC 9901) from a claims object, marking selected top-level claims as selectively disclosable via salted-hash digests in the _sd array, signed EdDSA over an ephemeral or supplied Ed25519 key. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/545-sdjwt-disclosure-workbench.html for interactive use, including the present mode (paste an SD-JWT, choose disclosures, optional KB-JWT holder binding).
